Predicate resolves its adopted contract; identity-bearing residuals resolve existing records. Effects record shared state at the predicate/evidence boundary; subject/evidence/provenance identify observed operation and observation without a nested effect-identity schema. grounding.quote:
Its

Every functor application binds exactly one functor kind and one traversal

Faithfully

Every admitted record has exact provenance or authorized model-local status; every evaluated declaration has retained, omitted, residual, inapplicable or refused treatment, with basis/authority for omission/inapplicability. Treatments are data, not verdicts. Evaluate preservation of material meaning: established preservation including authorized loss is satisfied; admissible fidelity counterexample falsified; undecided preservation/authority/materiality indeterminate; missing scope/capability out_of_frame; unusable subject/interpretation basis invalid_basis; missing cause follows AC-007. Overall fidelity conjoins required declaration/dependency predicates. O/E/C/L/X/V/T/J preserve objects, dependencies, predicates/consequences, variation, uncertainty and operational records; signature qualifiers distinguish premises, consequences, policy, observations and unresolved claims without new families/tree shape. Task views select Z/R and retain recoverable obligations, choices, evidence and open conditions. conditions: Encoding or admitted encoding is claimed.

Encoding requires `J_X.decision = accepted` and exact equality between the
judgment subject identity and digest and `M_X`; hold or refusal cannot be
encoded. `D_C` is a judgment over unchanged carrier bytes. It is not a
transformed carrier. The admitted encoding evidence relation is the exact
triple `(G_C, J_X, D_C)`; neither judgment enters the identity of its subject.

An encoding failure does not change `a_c.X`. An interpretation failure does not

None of these layers is automatically an independently released Product. The

urn:stdo:axiomatic-calculus-basis:sha256:

An external semantic-acceptance judgment points to that unchanged identity and

is the pair `(a_c.X, J_X)` where `J_X` is the applicable accepted judgment. This

grounding.quote:
This standard defines the generic relations `a_c.X` and `a_c.X.C`. It selects,
constructs, accepts, or releases no concrete interpretation or carrier. A
downstream authority owns its exact subject population, interpretation,
carrier, judgments, and Product or release status. The downstream identity is

Downstream authority owns subject population, interpretation, carrier, judgments and Product/release status; downstream identity never enters calculus or publication basis.

a_c is neither derivation-source compression/representation, selected subject model, carrier profile/instance, executable language/interpreter/compiler/runtime, deterministic semantic assessor/theorem prover, required graph topology, world ontology, authority registry nor a universal vocabulary/relation-set claim.

conditions: Spec selects the declared design/proof relations, or a boundary adopts the relevant profile.
exceptions: Referring to UP-016–019 or module-derived unit-proof law does not adopt the remaining profile.
ODD alignment, Python typing, UX and world-model refinements retain their declared adoption scopes.

grounding.quote:
This member owns generic design-contract law and an adoptable realization
profile. UP-016–019 and module-derived unit-proof law govern their declared
design and proof claims where Spec selects those relations. Referring to that
law does not adopt the remaining profile: its Ontology, Prime/IACS,
functional-realization, diagram and language policies apply at the design
boundary that adopts them, with their stated conditions and exceptions.

constraints.statement: At applicable admission/review, shared Contract application binds governing Product/requirements, accepted Ontology/design basis, proposed boundary and complete M(B), required evidence and actual design/effect grant; local implementation choice stays inside that admitted relation. This member owns Ontology-first, decision-complete sequencing, Prime contraction, IACS, three views and functional/effect policies; shared conservation/projection/currentness/result contracts apply at consuming gates. Acceptance uses core conjunction and existing design-authority decision, adding neither compulsory workflow nor second acceptance record. The table preserves distinct owned duties: durable admission/commit/competing paths with UP-021 owning enclosing admission; native constructability and bounded foundation comparison; Prime/IACS governance cost without numerical minimum from F5; bounded frames and reconstruction distinct from action lawfulness; computational projection with explicit execution binding and software mechanics only where software realizes; functional preferences without language/termination mandate; and views/proof/lifecycle with scope-limited reusable current evidence.

conditions: The relevant method relation governs the project or boundary.
exceptions: A module boundary is one bounded-traversal tool, not the only possible one.
Same-pass implementation/proof is acceptable only under co_evolution_admissible(B), with decision completeness before design-method closure.

grounding.quote:
Specification gives the global `WHAT`. Every intermediate traversal should have
a finite, inspectable unit for reasoning, implementation, evaluation, proof, and
later refactor. A module boundary is one realization-level tool for creating
that unit; it is not the only possible bounded traversal. Without bounded units,
reviewers and agents must traverse too much context at once, and correctness
depends on memory rather than on preserved structure.

constraints.statement: Intermediate traversals should have finite inspectable reasoning, implementation, evaluation, proof and refactor units. The method derives Ontology/architecture/realization after outcomes/capabilities are chosen; required functionality does not determine counts of entities/functions/operations/carriers/modules. It replaces neither SPEC constitutional authority nor ODD graph law. For ODD products it governs deterministic realization inside/beneath graph functions, traversals and GTL modules, without authorizing their replacement. Scope includes module boundaries, schema/carrier families, entity/record design and interfaces across languages/runtimes.
constraints.uncertainty: SPEC and ODD source contracts are not supplied.

conditions: The functional design profile applies.

grounding.quote:
This method does **not** require a functional programming language.

It does require a functional design discipline.

A Python, Scala, TypeScript, Kotlin, or Java implementation may all satisfy
this method if they keep semantic law in explicit carriers and transforms rather
than hidden orchestration.

constraints.statement: Functional design discipline is required, but no functional language is mandated. Preferred shape places meaning in typed carriers/explicit transforms, subordinates imperative coordination to admitted truth, isolates side effects to boundary modules and minimizes/justifies mutable shared state. conditions: The design method governs the boundary.

grounding.quote:
If a reader must infer governing meaning from orchestration code, mutable

Requiring governing meaning to be inferred from orchestration, mutable workspace conventions, services or fallback defaults is excessive coupling/imperative design. Current workspace observation remains necessary for actual presence/current contract facts but does not confer authority for intended meaning.

conditions: The method is used inside an ODD-governed product.

grounding.quote:
When this method is used inside an ODD-governed product, reviewers must first

If the boundary represents product movement from one typed asset state to

Module design must not hide graph functions in services, edge semantics in orchestration, continuation/re-entry in controllers, semantic target movement in constructors/materializers/projections or probabilistic workers in imperative prompt/dispatch code. conditions: This method governs the boundary.

conditions: A semantic boundary changes under the method.
exceptions: An explicit migration design may admit same-name/different-shape carriers.

The change must not increase truth surfaces; seam-closure work reduces existing
rival surfaces. Removing the authoritative carrier must make its consumers fail
closed, rather than reconstructing its meaning from raw artifacts, controller
state or payload fragments. [Ingress Collapse](#3b-ingress-collapse-rule)
governs raw input.

Removing authoritative truth makes consumers fail closed, not reconstruct meaning from raw artifacts/controller state/fragments. Projection/query publication applies faithful projection to named admitted carrier, runtime, event or source truth. Catalog, ownership, route, status and closure views structurally compare exposed relation with source before publication. Same-name/different-shape carriers refuse absent admitted migration; negative proof covers drift and missing source.

conditions: A change is evaluated under carrier consolidation.

Each change should collapse the slice to the few real identity-bearing carrier
families.

This means:

- declare the Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set first
- keep Subordinate Payloads subordinate by default
- avoid fragment classes, interfaces, or result records created only to satisfy

conditions: Boundary closure is claimed under this method.

grounding.quote:
- parse, validate, or construct first
- admit and narrow the boundary explicitly
- then use types or schemas to enforce the proved shape

constraints.statement: Typing, schemas, validators, contracts and codecs enforce an already real seam: parse/validate/construct first, explicitly admit/narrow, then enforce proved shape. conditions: Foreign, dynamic or weakly typed input enters a governed boundary.

1. receive foreign input
2. parse, validate, or normalize it once
3. construct local admitted carrier truth
4. consume only that local truth in semantic kernels

Once admitted it immediately becomes local carrier truth before semantic transforms: receive, parse/validate/normalize once, construct admitted carrier, consume only it. Repeated loose-payload parsing, round trips preserving open authority, loaders merely relabeling unvalidated JSON/maps and kernels inspecting open fragments are not lawful seam closure.

conditions: The functional-realization profile governs the boundary.
Additional kernel duties apply to the exact boundary claiming functional bias, pure transforms, immutable carriers, single-owner truth or low coupling.

grounding.quote:
Where a project claims functional bias, pure transforms, immutable carriers,
single-owner truth or low-coupling realization, the following additional duties
apply to that exact boundary. The semantic kernel is pure for the same admitted
inputs. Time, randomness,
UUID minting, environment/process/filesystem/network reads and global registries
belong to declared ingress or effect boundaries. Identity creation is explicitly
owned there. Invalid or incomplete truth is rejected at ingress; transforms use
local admitted carriers directly rather than re-entering parsers or loaders on
locally assembled truth. Defaults are explicit, ratified and carrier-owned.

They must avoid giant mutable workspace objects, semantic-law orchestration, hidden global/registry/service read-write coupling, typed envelopes over open truth, central payload mutation, helpers combining meaning decisions/writes and proxy interfaces retaining old authority. Claimed functional kernels are pure on identical admitted inputs; time/randomness/UUID creation/environment/process/filesystem/network/registry access belongs to declared ingress/effect boundaries with owned identity creation. Reject invalid/incomplete ingress; use local carriers without reparsing assembled truth; defaults are explicit, ratified and carrier-owned. Every function has clear owner/responsibility separating admission, semantics and effects. Algebra depends on carrier contracts, admission on validation; package/bootstrap/controller/adapter/runtime shells stay below semantic center. Typed effect boundaries preserve carrier truth.

conditions: This method governs a Python boundary.

- every function, method, and callable surface has explicit parameter and return

- semantic carriers are closed and typed
- repo-authored tests, scripts, and support code are typed too; they do not get

Untyped def, implicit Any, semantic dict[str,Any]/Mapping[str,Any]/object truth and unchecked JSON propagated through get chains do not count. conditions: Ontology-first policy is adopted.
An active semantic boundary is new or materially changed.
exceptions: A realization_refactor wholly inside an accepted boundary may cite existing Ontology/design and prove no ontology delta without reauthoring/reaccepting unchanged evidence.

grounding.quote:
A
`realization_refactor` wholly inside an accepted boundary may cite the existing
Ontology and design basis and prove `no ontology delta`; it does not require
re-authoring or re-accepting unchanged evidence. A semantic or structural
change must publish only the affected Ontology/design delta and its projection

constraints.statement: Derive semantic model from one accepted Ontology; before promoting new/changed entity, function, authority, effect, Prime carrier, module, public operation or schema, produce an affected candidate Ontology slice and carry it through acceptance. Design remains structural HOW for topology/interfaces/carrier placement/modules/algorithms; code/tests derive from requirements plus accepted design and preserve Ontology, substituting for neither. Acceptance identifies constitutional sources, accepting authority, stable element/relation identities and version/basis sufficient to decide source change, staleness and projection impact. Repricing invalidates only affected relations/projections until impact review; code, tests, generated schemas and an implementing agent cannot self-ratify missing authority. Material changes affect identity, authority, lifecycle, public contract, external Product meaning, cross-module topology or effect/closure law. Publish only affected semantic/structural deltas and impact sets; unrelated work does not freeze on a digest change.

conditions: Sequencing is selected for a governed boundary.
exceptions: Disposable spikes may supply evidence before an unresolved affected design is accepted without becoming retained selected design.
No separate artifact is required; use the existing work/design carrier.

grounding.quote:
decision_complete(B) iff
  U(B) = empty
  and M(B) is jointly satisfiable
  and every network admitted by M(B) is semantically equivalent under the
      governing Product, requirements, and accepted design relations
co_evolution_admissible(B) iff decision_complete(B)
design_gate(B) =
  the smallest causally closed affected set needed to establish

constraints.statement: decision_complete iff U is empty, M jointly satisfiable and all admitted networks semantically equivalent under Product/requirements/accepted design; co_evolution_admissible iff decision_complete. Gate is the smallest causally closed affected set establishing that condition. Neither co-evolution nor prior gating is global default. Co-evolution allows design/code/tests together with reconciliation before promotion/closure. Gating is required when implementation would establish unresolved/contradictory meaning or choose materially non-equivalent networks with durable consequences; accept affected decision before retained implementation establishes it. Proportionality selects material relations and bounds gate; removed downstream reasoning space is counterfactual contraction evidence, not an independent gate reason. Implementation provides counterexamples/ambiguity evidence, never upstream semantic authority, self-legalization or retrospective ratification. Record selection/basis in existing carrier. Hidden architectural ambiguity switches only affected closed set to gating; serial repairs do not establish acceptance. Repeated/cross-cutting surprises enter Universal Intake; if diagnosis establishes underconstrained design with sufficient requirements, require one bounded design_reframe and keep affected code provisional until accepted. Surprise alone proves no design cause; retain alternatives and upstream-change/observation needs before considering that gate sufficient. Prior gate is warranted only for material durable ambiguity whose contraction justifies reasoning load; without divergent alternatives it adds no disambiguation, while design still owns HOW before promotion/closure.
constraints.uncertainty: Universal Intake and governing proportionality details outside the quoted relation are not supplied.

exceptions: Local algorithms/layout may remain open only if every admitted choice is semantically equivalent under the accepted network.
Existing Ontology, algebra, mappings and views may jointly express the complete network without another document.

grounding.quote:
The boundary is underconstrained whenever `decision_complete(B)` is false,
including when implementation must introduce a new material semantic decision,
projections contradict one another, or two materially non-equivalent networks
remain admissible. Local algorithm and layout choices may remain open only when
every admitted choice is semantically equivalent under the accepted network.
Contradictory projections make the design unsatisfiable and block promotion.

Ontology, Prime, IACS, target design, domain/sequence/state views, contracts, modules, implementation and tests are projections of that one network; presence, labels, plausibility or mechanical validity do not establish completeness. Any false decision_complete condition is underconstraint, including new implementation-selected semantic decisions, contradictions or non-equivalent alternatives. Contradictory projections are unsatisfiable and block promotion.

conditions: An action is proposed inside M(B) under the applicable bounded-frame relation.
exceptions: One parent frame suffices only where actual governing structure is hierarchical.
No closure algorithm or recursive documentation of irrelevant descendants is required.

grounding.quote:
Evaluate preservation against every affected governing frame and update only
affected subordinate projections. Changing an accepted governing relation
requires re-entry at that relation before acceptance. Open a subordinate frame
only for a material distinction unresolved at the governing altitude; neither
a closure algorithm nor recursive documentation of irrelevant descendants is
required. A locally valid action that violates or silently reinterprets an
affected governing invariant fails this obligation. Duplication follows
[UP-018's action classification and explicit disposition](#invariant-reconstruction-sufficiency-stdo-up-018);
an undisposed duplicate cannot establish preservation.

constraints.statement: Contract application/composition bind accepted governing frames, bounded affected relations, inherited invariants, crossing authority/composition seams and subordinate frames for unresolved material distinctions. Governing structure may be a network of lifecycles, runtime/domain authority and sibling consumers; seam closure needs causally relevant far-side support or evidenced independence. Preserve every affected governing frame, update only affected projections and re-enter changed accepted relations before acceptance. Open subordinate frames only for material unresolved distinctions. Local validity cannot excuse violated/reinterpreted governing invariants; undisposed duplicates cannot prove preservation. Discovered verbs/actions/endpoints/commands/tickets/use cases are behavior evidence, not architectural operations, and cannot directly become public identities, peer carriers, modules or functions. Required derivation is constitutional functionality→candidate Ontology→logical completeness→whole-family Prime contraction→accepted Ontology→IACS→target/domain/sequence/state design→public contracts/adapters→implementation/tests.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-018's action classifications and disposition rules are referenced but not supplied.

conditions: Native constructability is required for design acceptance.

grounding.quote:
A missing substrate capability remains an explicit design gap or triggers
lawful re-entry. It must not be hidden behind a reference bridge, adapter,
filesystem runner, test double, or promised future feature. This is a
constructability obligation, not a prescribed implementation; the consumer
chooses the substrate and evidence mechanism.

constraints.statement: Semantic coherence is insufficient for acceptance if selected substrate cannot natively realize required identities, relationships, transitions, authority boundaries, effects, lifecycle, composition, publication and retirement. Missing capability remains a design gap or lawful re-entry, never hidden by bridge, adapter, filesystem runner, test double or promise. Consumer chooses substrate and evidence mechanism.

conditions: Before material algorithms, generic/common mechanics, new dependencies or locally rebuilt foundation capabilities are constructed/selected.
exceptions: No package survey or ledger is required for a trivial helper unable materially to affect authority, Product behavior, lifecycle cost or accepted design network.

grounding.quote:
Candidate discovery is bounded, reproducible, and explicitly non-exhaustive.
For every candidate category, the evidence record declares the sources or
collections searched, cutoff time and relevant version basis, applicability and
inclusion criteria, material exclusions, predecessor or incumbent status,
discovered candidates, and residual unknowns; a category not searched records
`not_applicable` or a named gap with its reason. Discovery closes only for that
declared basis and cutoff. A discovery gap that could materially alter the
frontier prevents selection; an immaterial residual records why it cannot change
the current decision. A later candidate that satisfies the applicability
criteria and could materially alter the lawful frontier invalidates the affected
selection evidence and re-enters this relation.

constraints.statement: Perform proportional selection; native constructability alone does not justify rebuilding. State capability without Product/domain/module/vendor/file/incumbent labels; distinguish irreducible relations with owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle/refusal invariants from mechanics/supporting capabilities. Candidate compositions draw from admitted project foundations, language/runtime/platform/standard library, accepted predecessor/immutable-lineage evidence, maintained externals when Product permits and bounded local implementation. For every category record searched sources, cutoff/version, applicability/inclusion criteria, material exclusions, incumbent/predecessor status, discoveries and unknowns; unsearched categories need reasoned not_applicable or named gap. Discovery is explicitly non-exhaustive and closes only for basis/cutoff. Material frontier-changing gaps block selection; immaterial residuals explain nonimpact. Later applicable frontier-changing candidates invalidate affected evidence and re-enter. Stay within existing Product/migration strategy; do not choose evolution versus re-adoption or override Spec presumption. Incumbents may constrain migration candidates and start discovery but confer no source-order/familiarity/sunk-cost/local-code/dependency-count selection preference. Newly exposed material generic subproblems recursively re-enter before retained implementation, distinct from later recurrence review.
constraints.uncertainty: External migration-strategy and recurrence-review rules are not supplied.

conditions: Material candidate compositions have entered the bounded population.
exceptions: A dominated composition may become selectable only if new evidence or a new material dimension invalidates dominance.

grounding.quote:
One lawful candidate composition **dominates** another on the current basis
only when every material decision dimension is comparable or evidenced as
non-discriminating between them, it is no worse on every comparable dimension,
and it is strictly better on at least one. A material unknown that could reverse
the relation prevents dominance and remains a gap. A dominated candidate cannot
be selected unless new evidence or another material dimension invalidates the
dominance relation. Therefore a local rebuild of generic mechanics is
inadmissible when an existing lawful foundation composition dominates it.
Unused feature breadth alone does not establish dominance and may itself add
lifecycle cost.

constraints.statement: One ledger/equivalent compares every material candidate on decision-relevant functional/constructability fit; semantic/operation-authority leakage; adapter/integration/migration/deletion/future-code costs; licensing/maintenance/security/upgrades/supply chain; package/runtime/startup/storage/operations; determinism/concurrency/failure/recovery/reconstruction/replay; assurance burden; and exit/replacement/reversibility. Hard authority, Product, safety, security, licensing or native-constructability failure eliminates. Unknown stays unknown, not favorable score; no universal scalar is required. Dominance requires all material dimensions comparable or evidenced nondiscriminating, no worse on every comparable dimension and strictly better on one. Reversal-capable unknown blocks dominance. Dominated local rebuild is inadmissible; unused feature breadth alone proves no dominance. Existing tradeoff owner may select only lawful undominated composition using exact-Product/basis declared priorities/risk tolerances and recorded frontier resolution; unresolved frontier remains a gap. Rejected material candidates record decisive evidence/falsifier. Fewest dependencies, smallest edit/line count, richest features or unsupported preference are not selection closure. Reuse confers no authority; assigned roles must preserve relation owner, role, subject, scope, basis and lifecycle/refusal invariants. Capability/provenance/authorship cannot widen/remint roles; local code competes under the same test and is not default.

conditions: Entity/lifecycle completeness is claimed in the active Ontology boundary.
exceptions: Subordinate payload/value objects inherit owner lifecycle/authority unless they pass Promotion Test and need no ceremonial peer row.
An equivalent closed representation may replace the matrix.

grounding.quote:
Every cell must identify a lawful function, declare `not_applicable` with a
reason, or name a `Gap:` / `Unanswered:` item and owner. Silence is not
logical-completeness evidence.

constraints.statement: Enumerate boundary entities, identities, relationships, cardinalities, invariants, lifecycle states and authority owners. For each identity-bearing entity or independently governed value family provide Entity/Identity/Authority owner/Declare-create/Read-project/Update-transition/Delete-retire matrix or equivalent. Each cell identifies lawful function, reasoned not_applicable or named Gap/Unanswered with owner; silence proves nothing. Columns ask completeness, not mutable CRUD: create may declare/construct/admit/materialize; read normally typed projection; update normally admitted transition/new version; deletion normally retirement/revocation/decommission/supersession where history/identity remains true. Domain lifecycle is distinct from section 6C operational build/release/deploy/observe/retire confirmation.
constraints.uncertainty: Promotion Test and section 6C are not supplied.

conditions: An Ontology function/transition crosses a semantic, authority, admission, effect, persistence or public boundary.
exceptions: Pure subordinate helpers inherit their owning function's authority envelope and need no peer row unless they cross a named boundary.
One owner may fill multiple roles only with explicit governing authority.

grounding.quote:
One owner may lawfully occupy more than one role only when the governing
authority explicitly says so. Role coincidence must not be inferred from
implementation convenience.

constraints.statement: Authority belongs to Ontology before operation shape selection. Provide Function/transition, Proposer, Evaluator, Verifier, Admitter, Executor, Projector and Retirement owner matrix/equivalent. Distinguish actor from authority, capability from currently admitted grant, proposal from all other roles, attribution from permission and domain-meaning ownership from runtime-effect ownership. Apply shared authority law to composed/higher-order inputs, constituents, projections and current basis; bind admitted grants and downstream witnesses. Delegation, elevation, transfer and retirement authority require named typed transitions with owning admission boundary.
constraints.uncertainty: Full shared authority semantics are external.

conditions: A consequential transition domain or material admission relation is designed.
exceptions: Unsupported composite/nested forms are not_applicable only if accepted domain/design excludes them and no weaker/competing path exists.
Disjoint entity identities or authority scopes are not counterexamples to singularity.

grounding.quote:
This obligation is false if a field, owner, or supported boundary is missing or
invented downstream; basis continuity, partial-failure boundary coverage or its
dominance/equivalence proof, or reconstruction is left to implementation
inference; or non-applicability is established only by a parser, helper, or
manufactured refusal.

constraints.statement: A role matrix alone is insufficient. Evidence includes entity-transition domain, predecessor, candidate family, admission relation, durable result and competing-path disposition. Accepted design declares every admission owner/supported boundary; exact admission-valid basis and predecessor/currentness continuity including equal/coherent multi-owner bases; complete enclosing relation, participants and equality joins; refusal/effect boundaries; full semantic commit unit/decomposability and every material post-validation partial-publication boundary, or named representative dominance/equivalence proof covering the full partial-failure surface; reconstruction and supported direct/composite/nested forms; competing paths. Qualification is per owner/boundary under UP-021. Missing/downstream-invented fields, owners or boundaries, inferred continuity/coverage/reconstruction or parser/helper/manufactured-refusal nonapplicability falsify the obligation. Singularity permits multiple actors/stages/implementations as declared constituents or disjoint instances, including one actor, multisignature, quorum, human step-up, proxy or jurisdiction partitions with declared cardinality/adjudication. Equivalent competing paths need explicit constituent/replica/replacement/independent disposition, not automatic deletion; superseded responsibilities require distinct supported purpose under migration law. Projection candidates re-enter admission on explicit predecessor; reconstructed projection is not self-authenticating. The law is false for reachable materially non-equivalent admission relations on the same domain/entity/scope/predecessor, undispositioned equivalent implementations or projection reactions self-authenticating from reconstruction.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-021 and Core Interface Migration Rule remain external.

conditions: The declared candidate and predecessor are assessed for admission on a scoped entity.

grounding.quote:
A shape-correct projector candidate therefore requires authentic
current-predecessor support and the actual grant at this gate; those facts
alone do not establish the remaining admission conditions. Unresolved seams
use UP-017's declared affected set under the shared support condition. Basis
advancement before semantic commit prevents the effect and requires UP-021
current-basis re-entry. This is the existing admission assessment, not an
additional validation pass.

constraints.statement: Contract application binds authoritative current basis, complete design relation/commit unit, required support, actual admitter grant and durable-result/other outcome; these are semantic bindings, not new carrier. Use UP-021 predicate/reason map with continuity, currentness and authority as material joins, preserving its missing/stale/incompatible/unusable-basis distinctions, trust-boundary validation and separate assessment, decision and observed-commit predicates. Retain qualified domain outcome and performance/effects including nonperformance, partial publication and unknown effects; well-formedness is separate. Shape-correct projection needs authentic current predecessor and grant, still insufficient for remaining conditions. Unresolved seams use UP-017 affected support. Basis advancement before commit prevents effect and requires current-basis re-entry, within existing assessment rather than extra validation.
constraints.uncertainty: The exact UP-021 mappings and standing-test semantics are not present.

exceptions: Higher-order composition/effect algebra is required where higher-order behavior exists.
Iterative composition/effect/implementation discovery is permitted only when co_evolution_admissible(B); otherwise a disposable spike may provide preacceptance evidence.
constraints.statement: Ontology derives smallest parameterized atomic families completing entity lifecycles. Entity/projection/transition/policy/subordinate-payload-only variation should normally be typed parameters or closed variants, not peers. Minimum evidence maps discovered functionality to entity, atomic function/template, higher-order composition, effect class, authority and disposition. Every row is admitted-atomic derivation, declared composition, owner/re-entry deferral, current-Product exclusion or named gap. Name applicable composition/effect algebra, including appropriate unit/lift, sequential/parallel/applicative, fold/evaluation, retry/recovery, recursion/fixed-point and projection categories, and state identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws rather than hiding them in control flow. No monadic/category vocabulary is required; GTL/ABG or another explicit algebra may bind it. Reconcile every retained result into accepted design before promotion/closure; no private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint becomes an undeclared constructor.

conditions: Prime acceptance or conformance is claimed.
exceptions: An out-of-domain case may justify proposing a new candidate atom for design admission.
Atoms and realization units may map many-to-many if explicit and without rival meaning/authority.

grounding.quote:
Every accepted Prime atom declares the admitted domain over which its law
holds. Within that domain it governs every admitted instance. A later use case
composes or parameterizes the atom; it does not fork, shadow, specialize, or
reinterpret the atom locally. An out-of-domain case may justify proposing
another candidate atom for design admission. An in-domain counterexample
falsifies the shared atom and re-enters at that atom's design boundary rather
than authorizing a feature-local replacement.

An atom without a declared admitted domain remains a candidate atom. It cannot
supply Prime acceptance or Prime-conformance to a realization projection.

constraints.statement: Small/named/typed/testable file, function, class, schema, operation, diagram, module or owner category is not thereby Prime. Atomic functions require complete-family contraction before Prime proof. Every accepted atom declares a domain and governs every admitted instance therein. Later in-domain uses compose/parameterize rather than locally fork, shadow, specialize or reinterpret; an in-domain counterexample falsifies shared atom and re-enters its design boundary. Without declared domain an atom remains candidate and supplies no Prime acceptance/conformance.

conditions: Whole-family Prime review occurs before promotion.

grounding.quote:
Prime review evaluates the complete candidate semantic-atom family and every
proposed realization projection, not only functions, carriers, or each atom in
isolation. The family includes every proposed identity, authority transition,
lifecycle relation, topology, function, composition law, effect, and closure
law. A function-and-carrier-only pass does not establish whole-family Prime.

constraints.statement: Review the complete proposed family of identities, authority transitions, lifecycle, topology, functions, composition, effects and closure plus every realization projection. Ask whether operations are parameters of one function, commands are one entity's transitions, reads share source projections, implementations share higher-order functions; whether independent identity/authority/effect/lifecycle/reuse/public pattern-match semantics arise; whether all atom kinds entered contraction; whether every unit maps explicitly to accepted atoms; and whether projections introduce/duplicate/reinterpret meaning/authority. Individually plausible functions are not Prime if one parameterized template with closed variants preserves meaning/authority. Contract visible recurrence during design; later recurrence review is no substitute.

conditions: A material semantic boundary undergoes Prime contraction.
exceptions: Work within an accepted boundary cites its existing Prime basis instead of recreating it.

grounding.quote:
Contraction must preserve root authority and every retained semantic relation.
Reducing files, functions, operations, or authoring surfaces cannot compensate
for introducing another authority source or truth path. Prime evidence states
the complete candidate semantic-atom family; each atom's stable identity,
irreducible relation, admitted domain, and falsification condition; the
whole-family contraction relation; retained meaning and authority before and
after contraction; accepted loss; and the explicit total mapping from every
proposed realization projection to its accepted atom or atoms. Work inside an
accepted boundary cites the existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

constraints.statement: Contract each candidate atom, then the complete resulting family. Local irreducibility/conformance does not establish global Prime when identity, authority, function, lifecycle, topology, effect or projection meaning is duplicated. Preserve root authority and every retained relation; fewer files/functions/operations/surfaces do not offset new truth or authority paths. Evidence names complete family, each stable identity/irreducible relation/domain/falsifier, whole-family contraction, before/after retained meaning/authority, accepted loss and total explicit mapping from every realization projection to accepted atoms.

conditions: A design projection is produced under the adopted Ontology profile.
exceptions: Intentional omission/flattening declares accepted loss and a failure condition.
Implementation branches/test expectations need not be individually enumerated in Ontology when traced through requirements and accepted design.

grounding.quote:
The binding names its Ontology source and the laws preserved. Intentional
omission or flattening declares accepted loss and a failure condition. Target
design may add structural HOW, but cannot originate rival semantic meaning.
A public operation, message, transition, carrier or effect untraceable through
accepted design to the Ontology cannot enter the active line. Implementation
branches and test expectations trace to requirements plus accepted design;
they preserve the Ontology without needing individual enumeration in it.

constraints.statement: Apply faithful projection from accepted Ontology preserving named identity, relationship, lifecycle, authority, function and effect laws. Targets include domain/class, sequence/state views; authority/effect matrices; IACS; public APIs/registers/SDK/CLI; schemas/codecs/manifests/catalogs; architecture/modules; and code/test/proof inventories through accepted design/requirements. Name source and preserved laws. Structural HOW may be added, not rival semantic meaning. Untraceable public operations/messages/transitions/carriers/effects cannot enter active line.
constraints.uncertainty: Full shared faithful-projection semantics remain external.

conditions: Prime Law governs the design boundary.

grounding.quote:
A top-level realization unit is **Prime-conformant** only when it projects one
or more accepted Prime atoms without introducing, duplicating, or
reinterpreting semantic authority. A topological or effect boundary must first
be derived and accepted as a Prime atom. Source-code size and one-to-one
correspondence with an atom are immaterial.

constraints.statement: Derive atoms from logically complete candidate Ontology before top-level units; whole-family Prime supports Ontology acceptance. IACS/design/modules/functions/schemas/tests project accepted atoms, never originate Prime meaning. Conformance applies to functions, classes, carriers, top-level schema records and modules. Typed closure alone does not justify a new top-level type. A unit projects accepted atom(s) without adding/duplicating/reinterpreting authority; topology/effect boundaries first require atom derivation/acceptance, independent of code size or one-to-one mapping. Typical lawful reasons are admitted graph topology/branch, typed transformation, effect, admission/validation or projection boundary. Mere call-site shortening, unrelated aggregation, renamed old interfaces, wrapper shuttling, hidden mutation/fallback/orchestration, payload-only naming, unjustified public record detail, small-field carrier mirrors or typing-driven peer proliferation are nonconformant. Prefer composition, existing lawful functions and fewer sharper boundaries/families; purpose is preventing fragmentation/sprawl, not minimizing lines.

conditions: Boundary decomposition or Prime contraction is reviewed.
exceptions: Review cuts, units, runtime modules and work items may relate many-to-one or one-to-many.
Evidence is proportional to semantic change/risk; no artifact or review per concern is required.

grounding.quote:
Prime review accounts for governance cost as well as implementation count.
Contraction is not successful when it increases authority centers, maintained
truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manually reconciled
projections, or review burden. Evidence remains proportional to semantic
change and risk; this rule does not require one artifact or review per concern.

constraints.statement: Distinct review, realization, runtime and work-item boundaries must not be forced into one-to-one administrative decomposition. Prime includes governance cost; contraction fails when it increases authority centers, maintained truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manually reconciled projections or review burden.

conditions: A schema, carrier family or typed public boundary is defined under adopted IACS policy.
exceptions: Where co_evolution_admissible(B), Ontology, IACS evidence, code and tests may develop together, with acceptance/reconciliation before promotion or closure.
Subordinate detail becomes public only after passing Promotion Test.

grounding.quote:
When `co_evolution_admissible(B)` holds, Ontology, carrier-set evidence,
implementation, and tests may develop together. Implementation may expose a
missing entity, relation, function, or carrier, but it cannot self-ratify that
meaning. Before the affected boundary is promoted or claims design-method
closure, the Ontology and IACS must be accepted and the typed implementation
reconciled to them. Under design-gated sequencing, the affected unresolved,
contradictory, or materially non-equivalent relation is accepted before
retained implementation establishes it.

constraints.statement: Derive IACS from accepted Ontology before naming subordinate payloads or implementation modules; it should be named before helper results/internal branches. Illustrative irreducible roles are source truth, admission, execution, yielded/recovery, effect plan and public projection. Branch payloads, persistence detail, read rows and typing-only field groups do not automatically justify peers. Evidence cites accepted Ontology/function derivation, declares IACS, maps every carrier to identity/lifecycle/function/authority/effect/projection law, distinguishes authoritative/downstream carriers, defaults all other shapes to private subordinate payloads and reconciles typed implementation before closure. IACS cannot replace Ontology or originate entity/function/lifecycle/authority meaning. Missing declared accepted Ontology or IACS means schema is not yet design-method complete. Implementation may expose missing meaning but cannot self-ratify; under gating, accept affected unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relations before retained code establishes them.
constraints.uncertainty: The Promotion Test's detailed criteria are not in the supplied excerpt.

A model-family
signature specializes their fields, value domains, reference domains, and
admissible kinds; it does not remove, rename, shadow, or silently add a core
record family. Another fundamental record family requires an explicit
compatible calculus extension rather than an extra subject sort.

forbidden: Choose a representation without that relation-preservation/refusal proof.

grounding.quote:
The tuple is abstract. A carrier may use records, tables, graphs, terms,
clauses, code, or another representation only when its encoding profile proves
that every tuple relation is preserved or explicitly refused.

forbidden: Infer latitude from implementation preference, probabilistic choice or human presence.

grounding.quote:
Two values may differ lawfully only through an applicable latitude or
transformation relation. An implementation preference, probabilistic choice,
or human presence is not implicit latitude.

allowed: Applications may declare typed import, translation or specialization of a_c concepts under their own exact authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation law.
forbidden: Such external relations change the calculus or enter this standard merely through application usefulness.

grounding.quote:
An application may declare a typed import, translation, or specialization of
an `a_c` concept under that application's own exact authority, context, basis,
scope, preservation, loss, refusal, and invalidation law. Such a relation is
external to the calculus. It neither changes `a_c` nor enters this standard by
being useful to an application.

allowed: Inside ODD products the method may govern F_D evaluators/proofs, carrier constructors/admissions, deterministic transforms inside edges, effect shells publishing traversal results and projections over admitted carrier truth.
forbidden: Replace or hide graph-program semantics in deterministic realization.
Infer that the Design Module Method's F_D shorthand has the same concept identity as the calculus document's F_D without an explicit identity relation.

grounding.quote:
This method may govern:

- `F_D` evaluators and proofs
- carrier constructors and admissions
- deterministic transforms inside an edge traversal
- effect shells that publish the traversal result
- projections over already-admitted carrier truth

Nominal equality with a predecessor or downstream shorthand
creates no concept-identity, import, or equivalence relation.

allowed: Any, cast(...) and # type: ignore only when all four conditions hold: genuinely foreign/dynamic boundary; no more precise local expression; narrow, explicit use justified in place; and no imprecision entering the semantic kernel as governing truth.
Use suitable closed typed forms, including the listed Python forms or alternatives.
forbidden: Use those escape mechanisms as semantic carrier truth or to bypass an expressible local shape.
Give tests, scripts or support code a lower typing standard.

grounding.quote:
`Any`, `cast(...)`, and `# type: ignore` are allowed only when all of the
following are true:

- the boundary is genuinely foreign or dynamically typed
- the local code cannot express the shape more precisely
- the use is narrow, explicit, and justified in place
- the imprecision does not cross into the semantic kernel as governing truth

allowed: Design, implementation and tests may co-evolve only where decision_complete(B), reconciling before promotion or closure.
A disposable spike may supply evidence across an unresolved affected design relation without becoming selected design.
Existing work/design carriers may hold sequencing relation and basis.
forbidden: Treat either sequencing mode as a universal default.
Use implementation evidence as authority to choose missing semantics, rewrite upstream truth or ratify a decision after establishing it.
Retroactively invalidate unrelated work solely because affected architectural ambiguity was discovered.

grounding.quote:
- **co-evolution** is lawful only when `decision_complete(B)` holds. Design
  still owns the structural `HOW`, but design, implementation, and tests may
  evolve together and reconcile before promotion or closure;
- **design-gated** sequencing is required when implementation would otherwise
  establish an unresolved or contradictory relation, or choose between
  materially non-equivalent networks, with durable consequences for future
  change. The affected design decision must be accepted before retained
  implementation establishes it. A disposable spike may supply evidence
  without becoming the selected design.

allowed: Multiple actors, stages or implementations may be constituents or disjoint instances of one declared complete admission relation.
Declared cardinality/adjudication may require one actor, multiple signatures, quorum, human step-up, delegated proxy or jurisdiction partitions.
Equivalent paths may be explicit constituents, replicas, replacements or deliberately independent realizations; disposition need not mean deletion.
forbidden: Infer singularity merely from a single actor/component.
Retain superseded responsibility solely because it has a path label or existing test.
Leave reachable equivalent competing paths undispositioned or permit non-equivalent admission laws on the same entity/scope/predecessor domain.

grounding.quote:
Singularity attaches to the complete decision relation, not to one actor,
callable, or component. Multiple actors, stages, or implementations are lawful
as constituents or disjoint instances of that relation. A relation may lawfully
require one actor, multiple signatures, quorum, human step-up, delegated proxy
authority, or jurisdictional partitioning, provided its cardinality and
adjudication law are declared.

Competing-path disposition does not imply deletion. An equivalent path may be a
lawful constituent, replica, replacement, or deliberately independent
realization, provided its relationship to the singular admission law is
explicit. A superseded responsibility remains subject to `SPEC_METHOD.md`'s
Core Interface Migration Rule: retention requires a distinct supported purpose,
not merely a path label or an existing test.
